Know Your Tally Ledger — minor but useful additions:

• Export to Excel: open any ledger and export its full entry list as a clean, print-ready workbook — company name at the top, every voucher with date, type, Dr/Cr, amount, other leg and narration, plus Dr/Cr totals at the bottom.

• Reverse Entry: if a batch of entries has been booked the wrong way round (Debit passed as Credit, or vice versa), open the ledger, select the entries (or filter by Dr/Cr and select all at once), and Reverse Entry will pass the correct inverse entry for each one automatically. Note: it books the correcting entry — it does not delete the original wrong entry. After reversing, open the original entry in Tally and delete it manually so the books stay clean.
